title: SWF DefineShape export
description: Wire the SWF compiler to emit DefineShape4 tags for shapes in the document model. Walk each frame's scene graph, emit DefineShape4 (fill/stroke style arrays + shape records from ShapePath segments), PlaceObject2 per shape per frame. Verify output plays in Ruffle with correct shapes. Depends on swf-compiler-mvp, draw-tools-integration.
